name: feature-0030 실행 타임아웃 연장 — 관리 콘솔 설정 노출 + 컴포저 배너/승인 (PB-0008)

steps.label: runtime_settings_registry_has_extension_keys
steps.script: (async () => { const r = await fetch('/api/admin/settings/runtime', {credentials:'same-origin'}); if (!r.ok) return 'HTTP ' + r.status; const j = await r.json(); const rows = (j.timeouts||[]).filter(t => String(t.key).includes('EXTENSION')); return JSON.stringify(rows.map(t => ({key:t.key, label:t.label, def:t.default, eff:t.effective, mode:t.apply_mode}))); })()
